description: Lead the hero subtitle with persistent workspaces and replace Docker-only workspace copy with runtime-neutral copy.

userStories.title: Persistent subtitle and runtime-neutral workspace copy
userStories.description: As a first-time visitor, I want the hero to say the workspace is persistent and the site to describe AGRO without a Docker-only claim, so that the copy matches the Mifune Console and self-hosted AGRO.
acceptanceCriteria: The hero `<h1>` still reads exactly "A portable home for autonomous coding agents.", and `APP_DEFAULT_TITLE` is unchanged.
The hero subtitle reads exactly "Persistent workspaces for Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or any harness: isolated, and still working after you disconnect. Self-host it, or start free in your browser."
`git grep -n -i -E "docker (workspace|environment)" -- src scripts public/llm.txt` returns no match.
The FAQ answer for what AGRO is, and the `llm.txt` category paragraph, each state that workspaces run on a laptop, a remote VM, or a Mifune Console node, and that Docker is one supported runtime.
`npm run lint` exits 0, and `npm run build` exits 0.
